description: CREATE a booking (or apply+pay for jobs) holding funds in Midnight-blockchain escrow; read status afterward with everlist_booking. Requires a hub token in the X-Hub-Token header on the MCP request (header-only auth; obtain via the hub auth contract: POST /accounts/signup + /accounts/login, keypair stays client-side). human_verified must be true (interim credential; production = zk-personhood). Booking fields depend on the vertical (attendee / buyer+quantity / client / worker).

human_verified.description: must be true: interim human-attestation (production = zk-personhood)

idempotency_key.description: optional client key: retry-safe booking (same key = same booking, never a duplicate)

listing_id.description: listing id from everlist_search/everlist_listing, e.g. even-1

worker.description: jobs vertical: worker identity ref (the human who takes the job)

name: everlist_book
